text:
emily: Heads up — our KB scan flagged a couple 404s on /kb/runtime/caching and one dead link to `https://internal.redwood/guides/old-batching`. Who can grab this for a quick patch?

docs-bot: automated-link-scan: 3 dead links found in /kb/runtime/caching (severity: low). Report: https://scans.example/scan/1739123456

raj: I wrote the runtime caching guide originally but not the KB entry. I can pair on the redirect, can someone own the PR?

casey: I can open a tiny PR to replace the old-batching link with `/guides/batching-quickstart` and add a 301 redirect rule in the frontmatter. Will do in the next 30m.

emily: thanks — please add a short note in the PR description about regression risk (rendering + permalinks).

casey: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/1284 — small sed replace + frontmatter redirect. cc @sam for review.

sam: on it. I'll do a quick pass after standup (ETA ~11:15am). If it's purely link swap, should be safe to merge.

mohit: FYI this page is referenced in the rollout checklist for the caching rollout tomorrow. If we don't patch before 12:00 I'll update the checklist to point to the new guide URL so rollout doesn't block.

raj: quick question for @casey — did you run the local markdown build to verify no TOC/broken anchor issues?

casey: yep ran `npm run docs:serve` and spot-checked anchors. All good. I also added a test in the link-checker config to catch that path.

emily: perfect. After sam merges, can someone drop a one-line note in the #releases channel so infra knows the checklist link changed?

sam: will post after merge.

casey: merged and deployed (netlify build 572). Leaving the PR link in the thread for audit.

emily: amazing — thanks everyone. Closing the loop: docs-bot, please re-run scan tomorrow morning and ping if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: scheduled scan queued for 1739200000.
